护甲（轻甲、中甲、或重甲），珍稀（需同调）

这套色彩鲜艳、花团锦簇的护甲铸成于 妖精荒野Feywild 之中，它充满着那个奇幻位面的诱人能量。

穿着这套护甲期间，你为防止陷入或结束 魅惑&Reference[condition=charmed] 状态所做的豁免具有优势。

这套护甲具有3发充能。你可以消耗一发充能以用其施展法术@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.RpBbOYseLZCFXaFY]{强迫术 Compulsion}（豁免DC15）。这套护甲在每日黎明时分恢复[[/r 1d3]]发已消耗的充能数。

This colorful, flowery armor was forged in the Feywild and is infused with that plane's captivating magic.

While wearing this armor, you have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the &Reference[condition=charmed] condition on yourself.

This armor has 3 charges. You can use an action to expend a charge to cast the @spell[Compulsion] spell (save DC 15) from this armor. The armor regains [[/r 1d3]] expended charges daily at dawn.

Base items. This item variant can be applied to the following base items:

  • @item[Breastplate|PHB] (@item[Feywrought Breastplate|BMT])
  • @item[Chain Mail|PHB] (@item[Feywrought Chain Mail|BMT])
  • @item[Chain Shirt|PHB] (@item[Feywrought Chain Shirt|BMT])
  • @item[Half Plate Armor|PHB] (@item[Feywrought Half Plate Armor|BMT])
  • @item[Hide Armor|PHB] (@item[Feywrought Hide Armor|BMT])
  • @item[Leather Armor|PHB] (@item[Feywrought Leather Armor|BMT])
  • @item[Padded Armor|PHB] (@item[Feywrought Padded Armor|BMT])
  • @item[Plate Armor|PHB] (@item[Feywrought Plate Armor|BMT])
  • @item[Ring Mail|PHB] (@item[Feywrought Ring Mail|BMT])
  • @item[Scale Mail|PHB] (@item[Feywrought Scale Mail|BMT])
  • @item[Spiked Armor|SCAG] (@item[Feywrought Spiked Armor|BMT])
  • @item[Splint Armor|PHB] (@item[Feywrought Splint Armor|BMT])
  • @item[Studded Leather Armor|PHB] (@item[Feywrought Studded Leather Armor|BMT])
